name: PeeringDB (network, organisation, IXP and facility records)
tier_rationale: Established non-profit operating the industry's interconnection database with published AUP, privacy policy and API documentation (A8 trusted: 'All three operators are established non-profits or CERTs: tier trusted', P033 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Records are self-declared by the network operators and usually current; network type, policy and IXP presence are what the operator maintains, not independently verified.

peeringdb.description: PeeringDB API key (optional: raises the anonymous throttle; sent only as 'Authorization: Api-Key <key>', never in the URL)
peeringdb.plan_hint: a read-only API key of the team's PeeringDB account (free); keyless lookups work under the anonymous throttle

api.title: PeeringDB API: /api/net?asn=&depth=2 (operator, network type, policy, IXPs, facilities), /api/org/{id} (organisation name), /api/net?name__contains= (company name search)

terms.quote: Except for Internet operational purposes approved by PeeringDB, no part of the PeeringDB data may be reproduced, stored in a retrieval system, or transmitted [...] Any use of this material to target advertising or similar activities is explicitly forbidden [...] 'Internet operational issues' [...] would include network trouble-shooting, abuse reporting, and Internet research and analysis. It would not include compiling marketing lists, demographic mapping, or any other commercial application.

api.notes: Class 'open' is the binding council decision (P033 cond 1: 'PeeringDB (free under its AUP) [...] open, tier trusted'); the AUP quote above bounds the use to Internet operational purposes (abuse reporting, research and analysis). P033 cond 3: poc/contact objects are dropped at ingestion and never stored or reused (no harvesting or marketing); only role names are kept. The bare host peeringdb.com answers 301 to www.peeringdb.com (observed 2026-11-26), so the module calls www directly. Anonymous queries are throttled (about 20 per minute observed by research): min_interval 3.5 s, optional key 'peeringdb' in the Authorization header. Unknown ASNs answer 404 {data: [], meta: {error: 'Entity not found'}} (a documented absence). Used by asn_context.

notes: Created by batch p2-G02-1 (P033 asn_context). Other batches extend it (peeringdb__<suffix>.json).
